title: Deploy
description: bun run build writes a static dist/ folder. Serve it from any static host and point unknown paths at 404.html.

sections.title: Build
paragraphs: The build type-checks, bundles, and prerenders one index.html per page path plus a 404.html.
sections.code:
bun run build
bun run preview

sections.title: Hosts
paragraphs: Any host that serves files works. Configure the not-found page as 404.html so mistyped links still render the docs shell with search.
table: Build command bun run build, output dist

sections.title: Releases
paragraphs: When CI passes on main, a tag is cut automatically and the release workflow attaches a zipped dist/ to the GitHub release, so you can deploy a known version.
